component.name: AbelNotes
component.summary: Handwritten notes with LaTeX, PDF annotation and self-hosted sync

description.p: AbelNotes is a handwriting-first note-taking app for pen and touch. Write, draw and annotate, then keep everything on a server you control.

ul.li: Natural pen input with pressure and tilt; palm rejection for stylus users.
Import and annotate PDFs, with text selection and search.
LaTeX math elements (paste $$…$$ or \[…\]) and geometric shape recognition.
Sync notebooks to your own Nextcloud or any generic WebDAV server — no cloud lock-in.
Import from OneNote, Obsidian and Notion exports.

description.p: Free and open source (AGPL-3.0). No accounts, no ads, no tracking — your notes stay on your hardware.

screenshot.caption: Handwriting and math on grid paper
Your notebook library, synced over WebDAV

description.p: Disconnecting an account no longer deletes local notebooks: connecting a different account, or the same one with another base directory, used to make the library treat every notebook as deleted on the server and remove it for good.
The library re-syncs every five minutes instead of only at startup, so notebooks made on another device show up on their own.

Eraser and selection fixes: circles can be erased, the area eraser no longer wipes a filled shape when it grazes the border, erasing reaches the middle of text, and tapping inside a filled shape selects it.
A stylus tap on the tool dock opens the tool popup instead of quietly switching the mouse into drawing.
Linux stylus fix: pens that GDK mislabels as a mouse (some Wayland/Xwayland digitizers and driverless tablets) now draw instead of only hovering.
